title: Animal Motion · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Animal Motion · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Write familiar animals on slips. The lead draws a slip and imitates how that animal moves without speaking. The others name the animal. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Animal Motion, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
